core.description: Smallest safe NEKOWORK pack for local readiness and baseline rules.
core.use_when: Use for the first install, repo smoke, or minimal local-first verification.

quality.description: Disciplined development pack for test-first planning, evidence warnings, and strict quality checks.
quality.use_when: Use when acceptance criteria coverage and evidence-based review are the main risk.

security.description: Security review pack for sensitive boundaries, Codex challenge, and Human Gate policy.
security.workflow: ask --profile security -> run --profile security --secure --strict-quality -> report -> gate
security.use_when: Use for auth, tokens, secrets, permissions, deploy, data, or financial safety changes.

frontend.description: Frontend pack for mock-first UI work, component review, accessibility, and Codex verification.
frontend.workflow: ask --profile product -> team --workers product,security,test -> run -> report
frontend.use_when: Use for UI mockups, component changes, screen states, and accessibility-oriented review.

testing.description: Testing pack for regression planning, coverage-oriented handoffs, and quality gates.
testing.use_when: Use when the change mainly needs test planning, regression coverage, or CI confidence.

release.description: Release-readiness pack for developer workflow plus ops-readiness helpers.
release.use_when: Use when preparing changelog, readiness evidence, release notes, or no-ship handoff.

enterprise.description: Full stable pack for organizations that want every current NEKOWORK module without weakening gates.
enterprise.workflow: ask -> plan -> team -> work -> verify -> gate -> ship -> report -> apply
enterprise.use_when: Use for evaluation environments that want the full stable catalog with explicit safety boundaries.

developer.description: Daily development profile with quality workflow, Codex loop, and release readiness helpers.

product.description: Product planning profile for question gates, scope review, acceptance criteria, and handoff-first planning.

research.post_install_note: External research connectors remain opt-in and cannot weaken core safety gates.

full.description: All stable modules in the current release, still bounded by NEKOWORK core safety invariants.
